The specification describes a set of user stories related to Spring Framework, Spring Boot, Spring XD, Spring Integration (SI), RabbitMQ, Gemfire, Kafka, etc.

U1: Alternative DLQ configuration option to publish messages with additional headers (exception, stack trace).
U2: OOTB module to consume database changes as event streams (CDC - Change Data Capture) to synchronize with real-time DB updates to various destinations.
U3: Connect to broker hosting Rabbit queue for HA/FT cluster. Native support in spring amqp.
U4: Synchronize with latest Gemfire version (8.1). Depends on Spring Data Gosling GA and Gemfire 8.1.
U5: Deploy a stream in the same container (colocated modules). Leader election within modules for automatic failover.
U6: Upgrade to SI milestone/GA release for JMX improvements.
U7: Upgrade to SI Kafka release for latest improvements/bug fixes.
U8: Upgrade to Spring Boot 1.2.3 release and sync-up dependencies (logback, jackson, gemfire, h2, etc.).

activities.activity_description: Enhance Spring AMQP to provide a configuration option for an alternative DLQ, allowing messages to be published with additional headers containing the exception and stack trace (U1).
Create an out-of-the-box (OOTB) module to consume database changes as event streams to incrementally synchronize with real-time DB updates to various destinations (U2).
Add native support in Spring AMQP to connect to a broker hosting a Rabbit queue configured for High Availability/Fault Tolerance (HA/FT) clusters (U3).
Upgrade and synchronize with the latest Gemfire version (8.1) to leverage new features and support the updated BDS stack (U4).

Upgrade to the Spring Integration Kafka release to synchronize with the latest improvements and bug fixes (U7).
